2609.05232.title: Substrate-Aware AI Agents: Execution Context as a First-Class Input
2609.05232.paper_summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly select actions in environments whose memory, execution-time, runtime, compute, and operational constraints determine what counts as a suitable plan. We call the absence of this execution context from an agent's planning state substrate blindness. We test this general proposition through numerical code generation, where selected implementation choices and operational consequences are directly observable. Three frontier model configurations--Anthropic Claude Opus 5, OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol, and Google Gemini 3.7 Flash--generate code for a high-dimensional pairwise Euclidean-distance task either from the task alone or with a 128 MB RAM and 10.0 s wall-time contract. Contract disclosure reduced measured peak process memory in 13 of 14 executable index-aligned task-only versus contract-disclosed comparisons and reduced mean wall time in all three cohorts, making execution up to 3.1x faster. Across the audited corpus, disclosure produced structural code changes including bounded blocking, float32 retention, upper-triangle traversal, and in-place or memory-mapped buffers. At a tighter 96 MB contract, independently sampled contract-disclosed cohorts achieved correct-and-within-budget outcomes of 4/5 for Claude Opus 5, 5/5 for GPT-5.6-Sol, and 3/5 for Gemini 3.7 Flash, compared with task-only outcomes of 0/5, 1/5, and 0/5; cohort mean MaxRSS and wall time were 49-74% and 35-64% lower than their task-only references. These results establish a controlled proof of concept for substrate-aware agent planning: a minimal execution contract induces proactive structural adaptation in generated programs, shifting computation away from unconstrained allocations and substantially improving observed resource-time profiles before execution.
2609.05232.paper_summary_zh: 自主 AI 代理越來越多地在其記憶、執行時間、運行時、計算和操作約束決定何為合適計劃的環境中選擇行動。我們稱代理的規劃狀態中缺乏這種執行上下文為基質盲目性。我們通過數值代碼生成來測試這一普遍命題，在這裡，選擇的實施選擇和操作後果是直接可觀察的。三個前沿模型配置——Anthropic Claude Opus 5、OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Google Gemini 3.7 Flash——從任務本身或配備 128 MB RAM 和 10.0 秒牆時的合約生成高維配對歐幾里得距離任務的代碼。合約披露在 14 次可執行的索引對齊任務僅與合約披露的比較中，減少了測量的峰值進程記憶，並在所有三個隊列中減少了平均牆時間，使執行速度提高了最多 3.1 倍。在審核的語料庫中，披露產生了結構性代碼變更，包括有界阻塞、float32 保留、上三角遍歷，以及就地或內存映射緩衝區。在更緊的 96 MB 合約下，獨立抽樣的合約披露隊列為 Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash 實現了 4/5、5/5 和 3/5 的正確且在預算內的結果，而任務僅結果為 0/5、1/5 和 0/5；隊列的平均 MaxRSS 和牆時間比其任務僅參考低 49-74% 和 35-64%。這些結果建立了一個針對基質意識代理規劃的受控概念證明：最小的執行合約促使生成程序中的主動結構適應，將計算從不受約束的分配轉移，並在執行前顯著改善觀察到的資源時間配置。
